message.content:
I don’t have access to live statistics right now, so I’m unable to pull the most‑current point totals for each L.A. Lakers player. Historically—and through the end of the 2022–23 season—the franchise’s single‑season and career leaders were:

| Category | Player |
|----------|--------|
| **All‑time points scored** | Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar (38,387) |
| **Single‑season points total** | Kobe Bryant – 1,346 points (2007–08) |

In terms of *per‑game averages* during recent years, LeBron James has consistently led the Lakers’ offense. During the 2023–24 regular season he averaged around 27 points per game, which put him at the top of the team’s scoring chart. Anthony Davis also posted high numbers—averaging roughly 22–25 ppg—but typically fell behind LeBron.

If you’re looking for the exact “leading scorer” for this ongoing season (e.g., who currently tops the league table among Lakers players), you’ll want to consult an up‑to‑date source such as:

* [NBA.com](https://www.nba.com/lakers/stats)
* The Lakers’ official website or their mobile app
* Reputable sports news outlets (ESPN, CBS Sports)

Those sites refresh after each game and will give you the latest per‑player averages, cumulative totals, and even shooting efficiency metrics.
